sentences.en: The astronauts went up to the moon in a rocket.
sentences.zh: 宇航员们乘着火箭登上了月球。

sentences.en: The astronauts were greeted by their enthusiastic cheers and applause.
sentences.zh: 宇航员受到了热烈的欢迎和掌声。

sentences.en: People were delighted at the safe return of the astronauts.
sentences.zh: 人们欣喜于宇航员安全返回。

senses.zh: 宇航员，航天员；太空旅行者
